verdict: Paid channels are dark; Google profile engagement dropped sharply this week.
narrative: In the last 28 days, all activity on your account came through your Google Business Profile — paid advertising on Meta and Google generated zero spend, zero clicks, and zero leads. Your profile produced 42 total actions over the period (calls, direction requests, and website clicks), but engagement collapsed 87% in the most recent 7 days compared to the 7 days before, with the last three days recording no actions at all. The root cause appears to be very low profile visibility: only 328 impressions were recorded across 24 days, averaging roughly 14 per day, which leaves little traffic to convert into actions. We're reviewing the profile to identify what's suppressing visibility and will address it this week. Website sessions were up 19% week over week, which is a positive signal, though we're confirming the source before drawing conclusions.
